Rina (People Ops): Hey team — planning a short ‘Culture Honors’ sprint next week to surface tiny wins and hand out spot awards. Thinking: 2-week nomination window, $250 microkudos + a shoutout slide. Need feedback on rules.
Derek (People Ops): Love it. Are microkudos separate from the quarterly micro-grants?
Rina (People Ops): Yes — microkudos are smaller, faster ($250) for super quick recognition; quarterly micro-grants ($500) remain for higher-impact cases.
Sam (Engineering Manager): Quick question: eligibility for microkudos — can ICs nominate vendors/contractors?
Rina (People Ops): Contractors are eligible if they've been on project >30 days and have manager OK. Vendors not eligible unless on payroll. We'll add a short eligibility blurb in the form.
Priya (Product): For transparency, can managers see who nominated whom? Some teams prefer anonymous peer kudos.
Rina (People Ops): Nomination reviewers see anonymized text during scoring. Managers see final winners with nominators for follow-up.
Sam (Engineering Manager): OK. Can we enable a lightweight public leaderboard so teams can celebrate without revealing nominators?
Derek (People Ops): We can publish winner names and 1-line reason on Confluence and keep full nomination details internal.
ops-bot: Reminder: update your HR profile address if you want swag shipped.
kudos-bot: Microkudos form live: https://tiny.redwood/culture-kudos (internal). Remaining budget: 120 microkudos.
Priya (Product): Timeline check? When do nominations close and when will winners be announced?
Rina (People Ops): Nominations open Monday (1765401634) — close in two weeks (1766006434). Winners announced during the following all-hands; mini ceremony slide + Slack thread.
Sam (Engineering Manager): Shipping logistics: will remote winners get a digital badge too?
Rina (People Ops): Yes: digital badge, $250 grant, and optional physical token (pin/sticker pack) shipped if address present.
Derek (People Ops): Suggestion: add a 1-click Slack reaction flow — add :kudos: in #random this week to surface early candidates; People Ops will snapshot top reaction picks and prompt for full nomination. Low friction discovery.
Priya (Product): Let's do that. Also, can we add a coding tag for finance so payouts are tracked properly?
Rina (People Ops): We'll include an internal expense code field in the payout form and notify Finance for tagging.
Sam (Engineering Manager): One last thing — are microkudos taxable? Need to communicate to folks.
Rina (People Ops): Yes, will include tax guidance in the FAQ: small awards are taxable in most jurisdictions; People Ops will send a follow-up note with details.
Derek (People Ops): I'll draft the comms kit (Slack copy, Confluence template, short Loom) and share for review tomorrow.
Priya (Product): I'll record a 90s walkthrough for the form.
ops-bot: Announcement scheduled to post in #random and #company-recognition Monday 09:00 PT.
kudos-bot: Nomination window opened. Link: https://tiny.redwood/culture-kudos (internal).
